title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): a FAIL on the current head, or a head move that changes the reviewed surface, disarms auto-merge at once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQZkczRFmBwr8urZVj1Xj8F)_

Fixes #27809

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：PR 已挂自动合并时，若当前提交的契约复审判 FAIL，或提交被改动（如合入 main 时改了被审内容），负责席位读到即撤下自动合并；FAIL 记录写明这一步，重新挂上仍须当前提交有 PASS。
- 为什么改：PR #27667 增量复审 FAIL 后 20 分钟，仍凭早先挂上的自动合并被队列合入，主干随即变红（p0 #27806）。原规则只说落地前要有 PASS，没说已挂上的 PR 在 PASS 失效时怎么办。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` 下三处规则文字，不发布任何包，不加门禁或脚本；三个文件行数都没涨（删两句重复条文付账）。回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看：`references/contract-review.md` 的 head 后移一条（两行），再看等复核标记一节合并后的第一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`，预期都绿，contract-review.md 仍为 60 行。
- 需要你做的：暂无。contract review owed（契约复审未完成，席位复审后再求批）；本 PR 是规则改动，落地为 Tier H，由维护者批准。

## What changes

Rule text only, in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`. No script, no gate, no queue guard (triage: 「新增门禁默认否」).

- **`references/contract-review.md`, the one rule site.** The head-move exception bullet under landing check ① now carries both rules:
  > head 后移:纯重生成或只动散文面则原记录续管,落 `Regen-provenance:` 行;余移或现 head 落 FAIL
  > 而已挂 auto-merge ⇒ 派发席读到即照 AGENTS.md disarm 句撤挂,FAIL 记录点名撤挂;重挂照 ①。

  In English: a pure regeneration or prose-only move keeps the original record (with a `Regen-provenance:` line). Any other move, or a FAIL on the current head, while auto-merge is armed: the dispatching seat disarms on reading it, by the AGENTS.md disarm sentence, and the FAIL record names the disarm. Re-arming follows check ①, so it needs a PASS (or a `Regen-provenance:` line) on the current head.
- **The disarm itself is not restated.** It points at the one `disarm` sentence in `AGENTS.md` (governed-surface landing, "Already armed or queued when you read this?"): disable auto-merge AND convert to draft; neither act is measured to dequeue a queued PR, so ask the maintainer to remove it by hand, then confirm it is in neither the queue nor `origin/main`. The relay ops are `automerge_disable` and `pr_draft` (`references/rest-channel.md`). The dequeue facts are in `references/platform-readings.md` § queue membership.
- **Pointers, in place:** `references/landing-operations.md:12` (`FAIL ⇒ 撤挂,补丁轮`) and `SKILL.md:200` (`PASS 后 head 移 ⇒ 撤挂回等`).

## Why — measured

| Event | Record | Time |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Seat check after a main merge moved #27667's head to `af33de9c`; "Auto-merge stays armed" | comment 6510205555 | 2026-10-29T22:41Z |
| Triage: auto-merge is armed on a head no PASS names; the owning seat disarms until a delta PASS | comment 6510422663 | 22:54Z |
| Delta contract review on `af33de9c`: FAIL, two must-fix | comment 6510686343 | 23:11Z |
| #27667 merges at `af33de9c` through the still-armed auto-merge | merge `21c4bdd8` | 23:31Z |
| main `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` red on the two pins the FAIL named | p0 #27806 | after the merge |

`contract-review.md` on `fec60e00b` had no disarm text (`grep -n -i 'disarm\|automerge_disable\|auto-merge'` → 0 hits). Landing check ① said a PASS must name the current head before landing. Nothing said what to do with a PR that was already armed when ① stopped holding, so the seat left it armed.

## Line budget

All three files sit at their ceiling with headroom 0 (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`), and no maintainer ruling orders a raise. The rule costs one line (the exception bullet goes from 1 line to 2). It is paid in the same file by real deletion, not by re-wrap: the marker section's first and last bullets fold into one line, dropping two restatements:

- 「卡上副本在规则外、不是要求」: follows from 「单载体 = PR」, which stays.
- 「入队只认同形记录,标记有无不改判」: restates landing check ① and 「⛔ 不是闸门」, which stays.

Wording compressed in the edited lines only: 「只动上列散文面」 → 「只动散文面」 (the prose faces are defined once, at :9–10), 「继续管」 → 「续管」, `landing-operations.md` 「交棒请审」 → 「交棒」 (SKILL.md ③ is 「请审 = 席位交棒」), `SKILL.md` 「回等复核」 → 「撤挂回等」.

| File | Lines (ceiling) | Changed |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/contract-review.md` | 60 (60) | +3 / −3 |
| `references/landing-operations.md` | 101 (101) | +1 / −1 |
| `SKILL.md` | 319 (319) | +1 / −1, an in-place edit of :200 |

Every edited line is at most 120 bytes.

## Deviations from the dispatch order

- **The precedent is named here, not in the skills text.** The order asked for one clause naming #27667 → p0 #27806. `check:pm-skill-id-lint` refuses any `#NNN` in the pm-dispatch corpus, and the rules-only ruling moved incident narratives out of it. So the precedent lives in this body and in the commit message.
- **The disarm steps are a pointer, not a restatement.** The order's "relay `automerge_disable`, plus `pr_draft` where the repo's reading says disable alone does not dequeue" is already the AGENTS.md disarm sentence, which is stricter (both ops every time, plus the maintainer's hand removal for a queued PR). The rule points there.
- **Wanted 3 of the card** (a queue guard that refuses a head whose newest contract record is FAIL) is not built. It is the maintainer's call per the card and triage.
- `landing-operations.md:57` and `:72` (the seat's own `origin/main` merge) are not edited. The head-move half reaches every seat through `SKILL.md:200`, which is read in full on every fire.

## Verification

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths, derived from the committed diff against merge base `fec60e00b`) derives 21 families. All 21 were run with exit codes captured before any pipe. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (`@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` not built in a fresh worktree). It was re-run after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`, exit 0. `--ran` reconcile: `21 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Changed lines 10 (+5 / −5), under the 3000 threshold. `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `0a4b0fb2` is clean, and no commit since the base touched these three files.

Directly relevant: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (60/60, 101/101, 319/319), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:skill-frame-sync`. All exit 0.
</details>

Contract review owed: governed `.claude/**` rules text, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Landing is Tier H (triage 6512254201: 「A rule change: the maintainer approves」).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (prose only; the full run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. `.claude/**` publishes nothing, so `skip-changeset`.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 and quoted rule text are the sanctioned Chinese channels).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
